english.note: This is the all-purpose choice for temporarily looking after someone else’s child, including babysitting for pay.

examples.english: I’m going to babysit for someone tonight and won’t get home until eleven.
examples.traditional: 我今晚幫人湊仔，十一點先返屋企。
